expectations.process: Actual local Python stdio MCP handshake and tools/list report cwd, reserved root/data variables, opaque arguments and one-pass expansion.
expectations.data: Host config/plugin-data namespace hashes canonical discovery source plus stable identity, never package version. Package replacement retains data; distinct sources/identities cannot alias data via symlink.
expectations.boundary: Contained portable ./ command and cwd; existing-prefix canonicalization allows missing cwd but never creates package directories. Paths re-audited immediately before spawn. Native plugin ACP arrays cannot supply host context metadata.
expectations.legacy: Explicit host cwd resolves relative to package; local environment references are supported with missing/remote sources denied. Unconfigured cwd and arguments retain host behavior.
expectations.scope: Only local-host execution is implemented. No remote environment/PathUri is converted to a local path. Remote execution remains explicit unsupported, and HTTP credentials/lifecycle remain later tasks.
expectations.security_difference: Host cwd is contained even for legacy declarations and reserved host env cannot be overridden; these are deliberate fail-closed restrictions. Portable lexical parent-component rejection established by earlier path audit is retained.
